clips.title: The story
paras: Zenn Foulhoof draws newcomers into his schemes north of the road from Shadowglen to Dolanaar. The solitary satyr asks them to gather animal parts, preying on their trust and naivety.

Travelers on the path from Shadowglen to Dolanaar may find Zenn Foulhoof beneath the Great Tree. The satyr offers material rewards and secrets for simple work, asking for nightsaber fangs, strigid owl feathers, and webwood spider silk from the surrounding woods. He whispers conspiratorially, urging travelers to keep their bargain between themselves.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Eager for work, I see. Lucky for you a day never goes by that I don't wish I had a fledgling adventurer to perform my bidding.
You see, friend, I can make you very happy and provide you with things you never dreamed of having. But in order for that to happen you must bring me certain items.
My business in the forest often requires certain...reagents. Fetch for me 3 Nightsaber Fangs, 3 Strigid Owl Feathers and 3 swatches of Webwood Spider Silk.
Let's keep this our little secret, night elf.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you been a busy little bee, friend? I've been waiting for you to bring me what I need.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Who would have ever guessed that I, Zenn Foulhoof, would have a traveler to do my bidding? Certainly not me! But so it goes... This beloved world of ours is full of surprises.
Three cheers for the naive and gullible!
